projectDescription: A modern, AI-integrated Hyprland desktop shell built with QML/Quickshell, featuring dynamic theming, smart system monitoring, and a fully customizable UI.
keyFeatures: AI System Daemon for autonomous CPU/RAM/temperature monitoring and root-cause analysis
Smart Capsule: interactive AI-powered island for weather, media, and system stats
Deep theming with Material 3 dynamic color generation from wallpapers
Support for GIF and video wallpapers with depth-effect overlays
Built-in Settings App for visual configuration without editing config files
Asynchronous QML/Quickshell architecture on Hyprland for speed and fluidity
Multiple preset themes: Dracula, Catppuccin, Material You, Nord, Gruvbox, Tokyo Night
Background services: weather, music (MPRIS), clipboard, notifications, audio, brightness
publicApiSurface: ThemeManager — manages theme loading and Hyprland color updates
WallpaperController — controls wallpaper display and depth effects
SystemService — CPU, RAM, temperature monitoring and AI analysis
Weather — fetches and summarizes weather from wttr.in
NotifManager — notification management with do-not-disturb mode
AiService / AiAnalysisService — AI provider integration (Gemini etc.)
App.qml — unified service paths and command launcher
shell.qml — main QML shell entry point
